title: AW28 Toddler Girls' Assortment and Pricing Strategy
summary: Assortment and pricing for AW28 toddler girls.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 kidswear fairs take place in January 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fairs, kidswear brands' long-term practices and market drivers, and will be updated as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Fashion entered 2027 expecting low single-digit growth, with markdown risk and faster growth in resale<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Assortment
sections.body:
| Tier | What goes in it |
|---|---|
| Core | Basics, cords, fleece |
| Seasonal | Coats, velvet |
| Statement | Festive |

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: - Full price on outerwear and merino.

design_implications:
- Fewer styles, more combinations.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Track sales-to-stock weekly; plan resale and rework routes.

sources.title: Fashion: 2027, the year growth will finally have to be profitable
